rows.en:
So it's finally my turn, huh?
I got sick of waiting.
Alright, before I start, let me introduce myself.
The name's Makoto Shindo.
Third-year.
Nice to meet you.
Now, let's get right to it.
Since I'm the one closing things out, I brought a real special one I'd been saving.
...Have you guys ever used the library at this school?
Me... to tell the truth, not much.
I'd rather be moving around than reading books anyway.
Reading books just kinda wears me out.
Manga's fine, though.
If our school library stocked manga, I might actually use it more.
What about you, {a}?{p}Do you like books?
I like them
I don't like them
Neither, really

Figured.
You've got just the face for it.
But listen, you shouldn't spend all your time reading.
Get some exercise once in a while.
...Still, if you like books, our library might be right up your alley.{p}

After all, it's got as many books as any public library around.
And get this: way back, the son of some big shot from some foreign country went to our school.
And supposedly, a mountain of weird, pricey-looking books nobody could make heads or tails of got donated because of it.
No matter how valuable books like that are, nobody's ever gonna read them, right?
The school would've been a lot happier with a cash donation, I bet, but they couldn't exactly say no.
And once they had them, they couldn't just go and sell them off either.
So the story goes, there's a whole pile of books nobody's ever read stashed in the back of the library.
It's a pretty well-known story.
Even a guy like me who never goes near the library knows it.
So here's the thing: mixed in with those donated books, there's supposed to be one cursed book.
Nobody knows why a book like that got donated.
Maybe it got mixed in by chance, or maybe somebody just made a mistake.
...Or maybe it was on purpose.{p}

Well, none of that matters.
The book's there either way.
So, for today, I actually went and found out that book's title and where it's kept.
Got it from somebody in my class.
How did they know about it, you ask?
Well, never mind that.
So, what do you say?{p}Want to go to the library right now and take a look at that book?
Go to the library
Don't go to the library

That's the spirit. Otherwise it's no fun.
Alright, let's go right now.
...I'd never set foot in the library unless it was for something like this, anyway.
To tell you the truth, this'll be my first time seeing that book too.
I mean, it's more fun that way, right?{p}

...Here we are.
Hang on a sec, I gotta look up where the book is.
...This is it.
No doubt about it.{p}

Well?
You can't read what it says, can you?
Supposedly it's some kind of ancient script.
Man, what a grimy old book.
So, {a}.
I've got a favor to ask you.{p}Of course you'll do me this favor, right?
I'll do it
I'd rather not
Depends on what it is...

I see.
Well, that's fair enough.
You can't just say yes without knowing what the favor is.
Alright, I'll tell you the favor first.
If you're okay with it, then you can do it for me.{p}

Here's the thing: I want you to put your hand on this book's cover.
See? Easy, right?
What's with that face? You look almost let down.
Go on, put it there.{p}You can do that much for me, right?
Put my hand on the cover
Don't put my hand on it

Good.
Put it so it covers up the picture drawn on the cover.
...Good.
Okay, you can take your hand off now.
Now comes the real show.{p}

See, this book supposedly devours the soul of whoever it curses.
Who does it curse, you ask?
Whoever put their hand on it, obviously.
In other words, you.{p}

Ahahahahaha...
Hey, don't get mad.
Of course, it doesn't curse just anybody.
If you answer the questions I ask you, you won't get cursed.
Got it?{p}

...Do you believe what I'm telling you?
Maybe you don't, huh?
If you don't believe it, that's fine by me.
I'll just drop the whole thing.
So which is it?{p}Give me a straight answer.
I believe it
I don't believe it

Is that right.
Then that's fine.
Alright, I'll ask you the questions.
Answer them seriously.

If you just answer any old way, you're the one who'll be in trouble.
I mean, whether you get cursed or not is your problem.
It's got nothing to do with my life.
Got it?{p}

Let's start the questions.
Have you ever told a lie in your life?{p}Answer honestly.
Yes, I have
No, I haven't
I see.
Okay, next question.{p}Have you ever wanted to die?
Yes, I have
No, I haven't

...Is that the truth?
Alright, next question.
Have you ever wanted to kill someone?
Yes, I have
No, I haven't

...Is that really so?
If you lied, I'll give you one chance. Just one.{p}Is what you just said the truth?
It's the truth
Actually, I lied

Good.
Okay, next.{p}Have you ever hurt someone?
Yes, I have
No, I haven't
Have you ever betrayed someone?
Yes, I have
No, I haven't

...Hahaha.
I figured.
People betray others all the time without even noticing.
Just being aware of it means maybe even you've got a little humanity in you.{p}
Alright, next.{p}Do you think people hate you?
I think people hate me
I don't think they do

Right.
You betray people, so of course you'd be hated.{p}
Okay, next.{p}Do you think someone holds a grudge against you?
Someone holds a grudge
Nobody holds a grudge

...Hahaha.
You understand yourself pretty well, don't you?{p}

That's right. There's someone in this world who's got a grudge against you.
They're out there, no doubt about it.{p}

...Though maybe you haven't noticed.
And I've still got plenty more questions.{p}

What's wrong?
Don't look at me like that.{p}

All you have to do is answer my questions.
If you don't like it, you can quit.
Just run away, then.
Come on, next question.
Think back on your past.{p}Have you had a fun school life?
Yes, I have
It hasn't been fun

I see.
Well, good for you.
If you have a fun school life, it turns into good memories.
There are tons of people out there who had a hard, miserable time at school.
When you think about that, you're a lucky one.
Ain't that right?
On to the next one.{p}
Have you ever punched someone?
Yes, I have
No, I haven't

Huh, so you've hit someone before.
You're a pretty violent one, aren't you?
What?
Get into a fight or something?
Or don't tell me you just got fed up and punched somebody out of nowhere.
You weren't bullying somebody, were you...?
Well, whatever.
It makes no difference to me either way.
Next.{p}
Have you ever gone ahead and done something even though you knew it was wrong?
Yes
No

I see.
So you went and did it, even knowing it was wrong.
When was that?
What kind of situation lets you do a thing like that?
Why, you're a wicked person.
I mean, it's true, isn't it?
You know it's wrong and you do it anyway, right?
...Then maybe there's no helping it if you get cursed.
The questions aren't over yet.{p}
Let's keep going, then.{p}Have you ever regretted anything?
Yes
No

You have, huh.
So even you have regrets.
Then again, when you think about it, I guess that figures.
Having regrets means you've done that many bad things.
Well, it's only natural.{p}
Next, then.{p}Have you ever killed a bug?
Yes, I have
No, I haven't

Figures.
I can tell.
Someone like you has probably killed all kinds of bugs.
Flies and mosquitoes go without saying.
Crickets, spiders, centipedes... you've killed loads of bugs, haven't you?
Stomping them flat, ripping their heads off.
You'd never understand the pain of all those dead bugs, would you? Not you.{p}

Next.
Say your sweetheart was about to die.
If the only way to save them was for you to die, what would you do?{p}Could you sacrifice your own life for the one you love?
I could
I couldn't

...Really?
You really think you could die for somebody else?
...You sure don't look the type.
Well, let's not judge people by their looks.
People aren't always what they seem.{p}
Next.{p}Have you ever stolen anything?
Yes
No

Thought so, thought so.
For someone like you, stealing must come easy.
...Well?
Have you realized by now that you've committed every sin there is?
Have you ever felt like the weight of your sins was about to crush you?
Well, have you?{p}Looking back on the life you've led so far, do you feel any remorse?
I feel remorse
I feel no remorse

There's no telling whether that's true.
If you feel remorse, then you've got to atone for your sins.
Are you willing to atone for the sins you've committed?
...Before I ask that, let me ask one last question.{p}You... have you ever killed anyone?
Yes
No

...I see.
Then I'll ask you one more time.{p}
Are you willing to atone for the sins you've committed?
Yes
No
I see.
"Brace yourself!"{p}

"Gyah!"
The instant I tried to turn around, another blow slammed into my head.
What?
What just happened?
Why is someone hitting me?
My vision twisted and warped.{p}

In my warped vision, Shindo was laughing.
"{a}.
I'm gonna make you atone for your sins.
Right after you hear the seventh and final story.
...The seventh one was already here, see.
And they've been waiting for this moment."
Someone stepped out from behind the bookshelf.
Who?
...Who are you?
...Who is the seventh one?
...I can't... take any more.
I lost consciousness and collapsed on the spot...{p}

I see.
Well, like it or hate it, it's all the same to me.
You know what?
Our library's got a reputation for being something else.{p}

"I see... Got it.
Then I'll go take a look by myself."{p}

Shindo walked out of the club room.
..............................
We waited for him for a while.
But Shindo showed no sign of coming back.
Did a cursed book really exist?
Wasn't it dangerous to go see something like that alone?
I started to get worried.
...I think I'll go see how he's doing.{p}

He was holding a grimy old book.
Could this be the cursed book?
Oh no...
I never wanted to see a cursed book.
I shouldn't have come here...
"{a}. Listen, I've got a favor to ask you.
...Will you do it for me?"{p}

Good.
Then hold the cursed book and sing a song.
...Hm?
What's with that face?
I'm not messing around.{p}

This book carries the curse of a diva from long ago.
You hold it tight in your arms and sing whatever song pops into your head.
Then everyone who hears it falls asleep, or so the story goes.
Except whoever's singing, that is.
Here's the story behind this book.
Way back, a man fell in love with a diva... but she wouldn't give him the time of day.
So after causing all kinds of trouble, the guy ended up killing her.
The diva bitterly regretted having had no way to protect herself.
And that grudge latched onto this book.
Don't you think it's amazing, the power songs have over people's feelings?
A song can cheer you up, or bring back something sad...
That kind of thing happens, right?{p}

Apparently this book was in the room where the diva was killed.
It was a souvenir from some foreign country, a gift from one of her fans.
Back then, it was supposed to be a kind of good-luck charm that granted wishes, but...
Now it's a cursed book through and through.
It knocks people out cold, one after another.{p}

Hey, {a}.
Do you really think it can put every single person to sleep?
Go on, try it.
If it's for real, I'm keeping the book.
A book that puts people to sleep...
I bet it's got all sorts of uses, don't you think?
"Shindo..."{p}

I glanced at the book.
A diva was murdered, and a curse fell on the book.
For all that, the curse itself wasn't very scary.
All it did was put people to sleep.
Putting an attacker to sleep to protect herself...
Was that really as far as a frail woman's imagination went?
With a book that put people to sleep, I could do all sorts of things, like use it in some awful teacher's class or during a test.
But this... could be abused in endless ways.
If I could put everyone around me to sleep... couldn't I even rob a bank?{p}

"{a}, hurry up and try it.
Look... there are a few people over at that desk, right?"
With mixed feelings, I picked up the book.
Then...
"Oh, wait, I'm gonna step out of the library.
I don't want to be in here and get knocked out too.
Once you know how it went, come find me outside the library..."{p}
Shindo went outside.{p}Now... what should I do?
Test the cursed book
Go out and rob a bank
Burn the book and dump it
"Waaaaaaaaaah☆"
The people started slamming their heads into the nearby wall!
They were smashing their own heads against the wall, all by themselves.

Ah...
I dropped the book!
But this was no time to worry about that.
Some of them were bleeding from where they'd hit their heads.
Sleeping curse, my foot.
This was a curse that put people into eternal sleep...{p}

"A-are you all right?"
As I ran over...
"Ugh... my head hurts..."
"Huh...?
What was I...★"
The people under the book's curse began to come to their senses.
It must have been because I stopped singing.{p}

"{a}! What happened★"
Shindo burst in.
"I just heard you yell... Ah, you dropped the cursed book!
What are you doing☆"
He hurriedly picked up the cursed book, hugged it tight...
"Shindo☆ No, don't!
That's..."{p}

My words came too late.
Shindo had started to sing.
That sad melody...
And then I couldn't think anymore.
All I did was beat my head against the wall.
There was nothing else I could do.
I felt no pain.
If anything, it felt really, really good...{p}

I felt something hit me from behind, too.
Is someone hitting me?
Why are they hitting me?
I'm already hurting myself.
Why do I have to get hit on top of that?
...Oh well, who cares.
Right now I feel so good...
There's no blood on the wall in front of me yet.
Do I have to hit harder to make my head bleed?
Maybe I'll try slamming it a little harder.
Or maybe I'll try it on something with a sharp corner.
Thinking things like that, I felt my consciousness slowly fade away...{p}

A dark desire took hold of me.
I'd said I would do what Shindo told me, but I couldn't resist the sweet temptation.
With this book, I could pull off the perfect crime.
There was no way I wasn't going to try it.
Heh heh heh...
I grinned, hugged the book tight, and crept away...
Hm?
What's this?
A sad melody was rising up in my head...
Oh no!{p}

I forgot, this book kicks in when you hug it☆
Oh well, whatever.
I'll test it out here first, then move on to the perfect crime...
I began to sing, the words flowing out effortlessly.{p}

I decided to burn the book and get rid of it.
Shindo was waiting in the hallway outside the library, so I slipped out through a window and hurried to the incinerator.
Burn the cursed book and get rid of it...
Why had I thought of that?
Right after I'd declared I would do what Shindo said.
This was betrayal.
...No, it went beyond betrayal.
Frankly, I was doing something that made no sense.
What am I doing?
I don't know.
I didn't know, but as if obeying a fate already decided, I made my way to the incinerator.{p}

"All right, let's burn it..."
I flung the cursed book into the incinerator in one go.
